response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, frameworks), and a proven track record of leadership through workshops and open-source projects, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, organizational change leadership, or mobile platform expertise — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven leadership via workshops, open-source projects, and technical mentorship
Broad technical stack across mobile, web, and systems programming with strong testing focus
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership experience
Lacks documented experience leading organizational change or cross-team alignment
Minimal indication of mobile platform expertise despite role's focus on mobile ecosystem
